centre.description: The second-largest planet, flattened by its fast spin and circled by the widest bright rings in the solar system.
knownLimitations: Saturn's picture is a Solar System Scope map (CC BY 4.0) based on NASA imagery; its bands are a stand-in, not a view of any one day.
The surface drawn is the 1-bar cloud-top level, not a solid surface.

The rings are drawn as flat bands at the published radii in Planetary Explorer's colours; their brightness is a look, not a measurement. The gaps and thin rings the fact sheet gives no width for are not drawn.
The faint E ring and the F ring are not drawn.
